text: The accepted setState appends discovered labels rather than replacing the containers. resetState removes labels and localization IDs, hides bulk buttons and clears the available object; the controller calls subview reset methods when resetting the flow. For this widget, do not assume repeated setState calls alone replace previous resources. Recommend testing repeated population with the actual reset boundary before reusing the step in another route. This is a scoped lifecycle observation; duplicate rows after an unsupported repeated call were not reproduced. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.
title: Sync form reset removes generated rows before later population
